discovery-weak-signals.name: Technology bottleneck power
discovery-weak-signals.basis: High-NA EUV has reached production use and ASML remains the unique commercial supplier of EUV lithography at the leading edge.

discovery-weak-signals.name: AI infrastructure demand linkage
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Primary Q2 commentary explicitly connects AI-related Logic/Memory investment to stronger customer commitments and capacity planning.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Capacity execution
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Planned EUV capacity expansion can monetize demand, but scaling output of extremely complex systems increases supplier and manufacturing execution requirements.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Geopolitical/export-control exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Advanced lithography sits directly inside strategic technology controls and China self-reliance pressure, creating policy-dependent market-access risk.

expectations-execution.name: Execution versus narrative
expectations-execution.basis: High-NA has production evidence and Q2 operating results/order commentary support the demand thesis.

expectations-execution.name: Expectation burden
expectations-execution.basis: Capacity plans and reported booking strength raise the future delivery/utilization bar.

expectations-execution.name: Capital allocation
expectations-execution.basis: ASML continues a share-buyback program while investing to expand complex EUV capacity; both require durable cash generation and disciplined execution.

expectations-execution.name: Policy sensitivity
expectations-execution.basis: Leading-edge lithography is exposed to export controls and strategic industrial policy outside ASML's control.

thesisQuality.basis: High-NA production use, backlog and AI-linked commitments corroborate the thesis.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 profitability and raised 2026 guidance demonstrate strong acceleration.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current P/E and market cap imply a demanding expectation baseline.

catalystScore.basis: Capacity expansion, raised guidance and High-NA qualification are identifiable catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Profitability, liquidity and capital-return capacity support execution.

alignment2036.basis: EUV/High-NA directly enables advanced AI logic and memory scaling.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Lithography generations plus installed-base services reinforce monetization.

bottleneckControl.basis: ASML uniquely controls commercial leading-edge EUV supply.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Logic/memory/service diversification offsets but does not remove policy and capex risk.

substitutionResilience.basis: No current commercial EUV substitute matches ASML at the leading edge.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Financial resilience is strong while specialized supplier dependencies remain material.

pricingPower.basis: Unique capability and sustained high gross margin support exceptional value capture.

riskEvidence.basis: Export controls, cyclicality, supplier complexity, adoption economics and valuation are the principal risks.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current primary operating/technology evidence plus independent valuation lineage; residual unknowns are non-gating.

scoreRecord.thesis: ASML controls the critical leading-edge lithography bottleneck required for continued advanced logic and memory scaling, with High-NA production evidence and AI-linked customer commitments strengthening the long-duration thesis.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Export-control/geopolitical restrictions and a demanding valuation can impair realized returns even if technological dominance persists.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 results and subsequent evidence on EUV/High-NA bookings, capacity conversion and customer acceptance.

items.risk: Export controls/geopolitical restrictions can reduce addressable demand.
Specialized supplier and assembly throughput can constrain planned capacity expansion.
Current valuation creates a high expectation burden.
EUV/High-NA capacity expansion depends on a specialized supplier network and successful industrialization; demand visibility does not eliminate throughput constraints.
Export-control tightening or customer-country restrictions can reduce addressable demand and increase compliance complexity.
China's accelerated advanced-manufacturing self-reliance is a long-horizon substitution pressure even though no current commercial peer has displaced ASML at leading-edge EUV.
Security-level valuation attractiveness is not asserted because no canonical live valuation/entry input was part of this work item; this is non-gating.
A higher booked/capacity expectation base increases downside sensitivity to AI-capex normalization, customer fab delays or supplier bottlenecks.
High-NA's approximately $400M system cost raises customer return-on-investment requirements and can affect adoption timing even when technical readiness is strong.
